entries.title: Blasts reported in Iran as US launches new wave of strikes
entries.snippet: Iran says US strikes hit bridges in the country in an apparent escalation, while the US boards a ship in the Strait of Hormuz.

entries.title: Zelensky's removal of popular defence minister sparks protests in Ukraine
entries.snippet: A rift between Fedorov and Commander-in-Chief Oleksandr Syrskyi was apparently at the heart of Zelensky's decision.

entries.title: Teenager accused of carrying out sabotage actions in Poland for Russia
entries.snippet: Polish security services say the aim was to incite ethnic tensions between Poland and Ukraine.

entries.title: Fifa 'assessing match reports' over Falklands banner
entries.snippet: Fifa is "assessing the match reports" before deciding whether to punish Argentina after players held a banner in support of their country's claims to the Falkland Islands.

entries.title: Italian officials handed jail terms for Genoa bridge disaster that killed 43
entries.snippet: The ex-head of Italy's motorway operator Giovanni Castellucci was handed a 12-year term over the 2018 bridge collapse.

entries.title: White House teleprompter operator accused of making $100k off Trump speech bets
entries.snippet: A White House staffer has been accused of using inside knowledge of speeches to make nearly $100,000 on Kalshi.

entries.title: Hundreds of Canada wildfires prompt US air quality alerts as smoke spreads south
entries.snippet: Smoke from more than 800 blazes has affected cities from Toronto to New York, as well as the US Midwest.

entries.title: JD Vance accuses Israel of 'manipulating' US public opinion to prolong Iran war
entries.snippet: The US vice president says he thinks some Israeli politicians are trying to detail efforts to end the conflict.

entries.title: Kris Jenner's mother Mary Jo dies aged 91
entries.snippet: Mary Jo 'MJ' Campbell was featured on multiple episodes of Keeping Up with the Kardashians over the years.

entries.title: At least one dead in Texas floods ravaging same area where campers died
entries.snippet: The same area devastated by floods last year's floods, which caused more than 130 deaths, is once again being hit.

entries.title: 'Moment of joy' as Uganda discharges last Ebola patient
entries.snippet: The good news from Uganda comes as the WHO chief warns the virus in DR Congo is spreading fast.

entries.title: Volunteer firefighter suspected of starting devastating France forest fire
entries.snippet: President Macron said there would be no leniency for arsonists, as France - along with much of Europe - deals with a series of unusual heatwaves.

entries.title: Children among dead at Algeria foster care home blaze - president
entries.snippet: Eleven people have died and 19 other have suffered injuries in the overnight fire, the authorities say.

entries.title: New monkey species with orange lips found 'hiding' in DR Congo forest
entries.snippet: Scientists describe "amazing feeling" to look into the face of an animal that so few people knew existed.

entries.title: Fraud crackdown on Ghana ID cards makes digital checks compulsory - photocopies banned
entries.snippet: Companies are now required to verify a person's identity electronically to curb theft and forgery.

entries.title: JD Vance says Welsh castle was 'coolest thing I've ever seen'
entries.snippet: The US Vice-President writes in his new book that a visit to north Wales in 2013 changed his perspective.

entries.title: Chip giant TSMC pledges another $100bn to expand US production
entries.snippet: The company says it will create "high-tech, high-paying jobs", and raises its total commitment to the US to $265bn.

entries.title: Actor Sam Neill died from pneumonia, agent confirms
entries.snippet: Neill died in Sydney on Monday, with his family saying his death was 'sudden and unexpected'.

entries.title: US military to start screening for testosterone deficiency, Hegseth says
entries.snippet: Hegseth says he is authorising hormone screening to ensure US troops "operate at your absolute best".

entries.title: More people around the world now favour China over the US, Pew study suggests
entries.snippet: There is more confidence in Xi Jinping than Donald Trump, the US think tank's survey indicates.

entries.title: White House says ICE traffic stops will continue after deadly shootings
entries.snippet: The comments came following widespread reports earlier in the week that those stops would be put on pause after two immigrants were fatally shot by ICE agents in early July.

entries.title: Flood sirens blare in South Central Texas as rivers reach perilous heights
entries.snippet: Flood sirens blared early Thursday in Comfort, Texas, as the Guadalupe River rose more than 30 feet in three hours, the U.S. Geological Survey said. The storm could bring even more rainfall than last year's deadly Fourth of July floods.

entries.title: After years of false claims on voting, Trump to give an address on election integrity
entries.snippet: President Trump, who for years has sowed doubt about the security of American elections, is scheduled to give a primetime address Thursday night about election integrity. Trump has long contended, without evidence, that he won the 2020 election

entries.title: Dangerous wildfire smoke continues to blanket parts of the U.S.
entries.snippet: Orange skies and heavy smoke covered large parts of the U.S. on Thursday as Canada and Minnesota grapple with wildfires. Hazardous air quality is expected to continue.

entries.title: Why Orthodox Jews are opposing the new daylight saving bill in Congress
entries.snippet: Orthodox Jewish organizations say the bill, if passed, would force morning prayer services to start after 9 a.m. in some parts of the country, making observant Jews late for work and school.

entries.title: Officials probe whether White House teleprompter operator profited off Trump's words
entries.snippet: It's the first known instance of officials investigating suspected insider trading on a prediction market from inside the White House.

entries.title: Hong Kong official warns booksellers on security risks after raids
entries.snippet: The police operation marks the third round of arrests targeting independent bookstores in four months.

entries.title: Trump wants a permanent fence around the D.C. park known for White House protests
entries.snippet: The Trump administration wants to install permanent fencing around Lafayette Park, directly outside the White House. It's long been a popular spot for protesters, who worry barriers will change that.

entries.title: Zelenskyy fires Ukraine's tech-savvy defense minister in government reshuffle
entries.snippet: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has fired the country's popular defense minister, Mykhailo Fedorov, who pushed for innovation on the battlefield through use of drones and turned the tables on Russia.

entries.title: The political risks from war in Iran. And, ICE's use of force is rising, report finds
entries.snippet: The political implications the war in Iran is having on the GOP. And, a new report has found that ICE officers' use of force is not rare since President Trump took office for his second term.

entries.title: AI chatbots at risk of fueling government restrictions on online speech, new study says
entries.snippet: A Meta Oversight Board study released Thursday shows that major AI systems, including those built in the U.S., are more likely to refuse to criticize restrictive leaders or governments.

entries.title: Ava DuVernay announces '14th,' new documentary on birthright amendment contested by Trump
entries.snippet: The film will mark a return to nonfiction for DuVernay, the filmmaker of "Selma" and "Origin," and a follow-up to DuVernay's 2016 film "13th," her examination of the legacy of the 13th Amendment, which abolished slavery.

entries.title: Texas flash floods leave at least 2 people dead in Hill Country region devastated a year ago
entries.snippet: After days of pounding rain, the National Weather Service said a large wave on Thursday barreled down the same river wrecked by flash floods last summer when two dozen children and counselors died at Camp Mystic.

entries.title: As wildfire smoke makes air unhealthy from Midwest to East Coast, officials say stay inside
entries.snippet: Heavy, pungent wildfire smoke darkened skies in the U.S. on Thursday from the Great Lakes to parts of the East Coast, reducing visibility and prompting warnings that breathing the air outside could be dangerous.

entries.title: 'Jurassic Park' star Sam Neill died from pneumonia, agent says
entries.snippet: Actor Sam Neill died from pneumonia and will be honored at a private family memorial at his New Zealand farm later, his agent told The Associated Press on Thursday.

entries.title: U.S. expands attacks on Iran, which calls Strait of Hormuz a 'red line' as it strikes back
entries.snippet: The interim ceasefire agreed to last month has collapsed, and the region has endured days of back-and-forth attacks by the U.S. and Iran as they battle for control of the Strait of Hormuz.

entries.title: U.S. designates 2 more Mexican cartels as foreign terrorist organizations
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump began to extend the terrorist label to Latin American cartels in February 2025 to allow U.S. authorities to take more aggressive action against them or against anyone who the U.S. sees as aiding the groups.

entries.title: What to expect from Trump's address as he revisits 2020 election loss
entries.snippet: President Trump is expected to make new claims about foreign interference in the 2020 presidential election. The speech marks an escalation of his years-long effort to relitigate the election he lost. His repeated false claims about the 2020 vote have been rejected by courts, ele

entries.title: Election officials in Arizona's largest county agree on how to oversee vote, ending legal battle
entries.snippet: Republican Maricopa County Recorder Justin Heap sued the predominantly GOP board of supervisors in June 2025, alleging it illegally took control of certain aspects of election administration. The board called the lawsuit frivolous and said Heap was wasting taxpayer money.

entries.title: Trump setting stage to declare emergency around midterms, former White House attorney says

entries.title: Vote on U.S. aid to Israel exposes sharp divide in Congress
entries.snippet: Israel's war in Gaza and its joint military operation with the U.S. against Iran are fueling deep divisions on Capitol Hill, especially among Democrats. Wednesday, more than half of House Democrats voted to end U.S. military funding for Israel. A separate provision aimed at stren

entries.title: The debate over how to protect children and teens as AI use grows

entries.title: Experimental artist Suzanne Jackson celebrates decades of work in new exhibition
entries.snippet: Suzanne Jackson is an artist who has experimented with materials for decades. Now in her 80s, she's having her first major museum retrospective in an exhibition titled "What is Love." Senior Arts Correspondent Jeffrey Brown traveled to Minneapolis to meet Jackson for our Arts and

entries.title: Trump's teleprompter operator on unpaid leave over alleged Kalshi bets on Trump speeches
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump's teleprompter operator is on unpaid leave after reports that he used his inside knowledge to make bets about the president's speeches on the online prediction market Kalshi, the White House said Thursday.

entries.title: PolitiFact: Live fact-checking Trump's address from the White House
entries.snippet: Our partners at PolitiFact are providing live fact-checking of the president's July 16 address from the White House.

entries.title: America already tried permanent daylight saving time. Could it work now?
entries.snippet: It's an idea whose time, as it were, may have come — again.

entries.title: WATCH LIVE: Trump to address nation from White House
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump is expected to deliver an address Thursday from the White House.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Iran war: US military attacks Iran for sixth night running
entries.snippet: US Central Command said that a new wave of strikes was launched on Iran. It follows retaliatory strikes from Iran on sites in Jordan and Gulf states. DW has more.

entries.title: German tenants need better heat protection
entries.snippet: Heat waves are becoming longer, hotter and more frequent. Record temperatures have left many tenants struggling. Now Chancellor Friedrich Merz has said the building law needs to be amended.

entries.title: Why Gulf states are investing billions in Africa
entries.snippet: Wealthy Gulf states are investing billions in African countries. But the nations involved all have different objectives. What's behind the investments and what's in it for African countries?

entries.title: Fact check: Claims linking statins to dementia are false
entries.snippet: Viral posts claim that a drug widely used to lower cholesterol is contributing to a dementia epidemic. DW Fact Check examined the scientific evidence.

entries.title: Italy: Ex-highway head sentenced to 12 years for deadly bridge collapse
entries.snippet: The collapse of the Morandi bridge in Genoa in 2018 killed 43. The court found the former Italian highway CEO guilty of neglecting maintenance despite prior warnings and sentenced him to 12 years in prison.

entries.title: Monaco assassination plot takes a new turn
entries.snippet: A woman suspected of plotting to assassinate a Ukrainian-Cypriot businessman in Monaco has been found dead in Ukraine. Two men with ties to Ukraine's intelligence services have now been brought into custody.

entries.title: Why America's hospitals keep looking to India for nurses
entries.snippet: Thousands of Indian nurses aspire to work in the US, navigating yearslong visa backlogs to fill a growing healthcare workforce shortage.

entries.title: As the world rearms, South Korea aims to cash in
entries.snippet: Weapons and military equipment produced in South Korea are sought-after due to their reliability, speedy delivery times and relatively low prices. Global demand for weapons has surged after Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

entries.title: Germany massively expands federal police powers
entries.snippet: The German government has expanded the powers of its federal police, especially in the use of surveillance, AI, and drone defenses. But experts warn of constitutional challenges.

entries.title: Germany: Gender switch neo-Nazi sent to men's prison
entries.snippet: Far-right provocateur Marla Svenja Liebich was transferred to a men's prison after being extradited from the Czech Republic. Authorities say the decision took into account the safety of prisoners at a women's facility.

entries.title: Algeria: Fire at orphanage kills 11, including children
entries.snippet: A fire at an orphanage in the province of Algiers has killed 11 people and injured 19 more, authorities said. President Abdelmadjid Tebboune expressed his condolences amid his trip to Berlin.

entries.title: EU court endorses Spanish PM's contentious Catalan amnesty
entries.snippet: The EU's top court has backed a Spanish law giving amnesty to Catalan separatists over the independence referendum. The deal let Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez stay in office in 2023 and prompted major opposition protests.

entries.title: Germany may make it illegal to deny Israel's right to exist
entries.snippet: Germany's upper house of parliament, the Bundesrat, has introduced a bill seeking to ban the questioning of Israel's right to exist. It is now up to the lower house to decide whether to turn it into law.

entries.title: The EU climate policy the world copied is under fire — what's at stake?
entries.snippet: The emissions trading system became a global blueprint for pricing carbon and cutting CO2. Now industry groups are pushing back against tougher climate rules. How effective is the scheme and where does it fall short?

entries.title: What's behind the Iran regime's 'revenge propaganda'?
entries.snippet: Calls for revenge over the death of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei are growing louder in Iran. Through increasingly harsh rhetoric, the leadership is seeking to mobilize supporters at home while warning opponents abroad.

entries.title: US slaps 25% tariffs on Brazil with election looming
entries.snippet: The US will impose a 25% tariff on most imports from Brazil starting later this month. It's the first action in the Trump administration's new tariff strategy, after the Supreme Court struck down its prior impositions.

entries.title: Ukraine lawmakers approve Koretskyi as new PM amid protests
entries.snippet: It is President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's second Cabinet shakeup in a year. He faces criticism for dismissing reformist Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov.

entries.title: Germany news: Inland shipping under strain as rivers run low
entries.snippet: Drastically low water levels in Germany's rivers has disrupted shipping on several major rivers. Meanwhile, police have recorded a striking rise in e-scooter crashes causing injury or death.

entries.title: UK calls for FIFA investigation over Argentina banner
entries.snippet: Following their 2-1 World Cup semifinal victory over England, Argentine players held up a banner claiming the Falkland Islands belong to Argentina. Political messages are banned under FIFA rules.
